findings.claim: The incomplete-input recovery does not present the required guidance to the user after opening intake, despite the artifact claiming that it does.
findings.evidence: On a 422, use-administering-entity-resolution.ts lines 252-260 publishes the exact guidance into the case-detail view and immediately invokes onInputsIncomplete. CaseDetail's callback navigates to /cases/{caseId}/intake?focus=resolution at line 19, replacing the only component that can render that view message. intake-checklist-route.tsx lines 10-15 passes only a focus intent, and case-intake.tsx lines 55-110 renders the loaded form and focus target without the guidance. The retained tests split the behavior: the hook test asserts text in isolated hook state (lines 289-313), while the CaseDetail test asserts only the new URL (lines 69-86) and the CaseIntake test asserts only focus (lines 18-57). They never mount the navigation destination and assert that the exact sentence remains visible. This contradicts the OpenSpec requirement at specs/administering-entity-resolution/spec.md lines 50-52 and makes the completion evidence's visible-guidance claim unsupported.
findings.suggested_fix: Carry an incomplete-input recovery notice into the intake route through explicit navigation state or a narrowly validated query value, render the exact guidance in CaseIntake after the authorized full record loads, and add a routed component test that triggers the 422 recovery and asserts both the visible sentence and focus on the first missing field at the destination.
